newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's League presents 1,800 budget amendments.
newsitem.headline: Italy's League presents 1,800 budget amendments.

text.p: Italy's Northern League has presented around 1,800 amendments to the 1997 budget to go with around 700 amendments proposed by the centre-right Freedom Alliance opposition bloc, parliamentary sources said.
The centre-left ruling coalition said earlier this week it would present a limited number of its own amendments to the austerity budget pacakge unveiled last month by Prime Minister Romano Prodi.
The budget commission has until October 28 to examine all the proposed amendments and will then pass the draft law to the full lower chamber for debate.
The lower house of parliament has until November 17 to approve the budget, after which it goes to the upper house (Senate) for discussion.
The federalist Northern League has promised to use filibustering tactics to snarl parliamentary passage of the budget.
